newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-STUTTGART DISPLACE BAYERN AT HEAD OF BUNDESLIGA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STUTTGART DISPLACE BAYERN AT HEAD OF BUNDESLIGA.

text.p: Stuttgart went top of the Bundesliga on Tuesday with a convincing 2-0 win at Karlsruhe.
Bayern Munich dropped to second for the first time this season after Stuttgart's fifth win in six games.

Former German international Thomas Berthold headed in a free-kick in the 11th minute to put Stuttgart ahead and Brazilian Giovane Elber sealed victory with his third goal of the season in the 86th minute.
Karlsruhe, weakened by injury and suspensions, had Thomas Ritter sent off in the 79th minute.
Stuttgart's strong start has been achieved despite the loss of coach Rolf Fringer. He left to take charge of the Swiss national team before the German season began.
Caretaker-trainer Joachim Loew, previously Fringer's assistant, looks set to become the new coach. Stuttgart executives said a deal could be completed this week.
